'''2000 Calamari Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Calamari region in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Michael Josem]] of Melbourne, Australia won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />
